title: A Kaiji inspired game with AI characters and playable gambles? Is this concept possible? Or is AI too young for this?
author: Deiomo
selftext:
I always had this ambitious idea.

Where you can actually play the gambling death games interactively like an actual video game from Kaiji (or any other franchises with death games) like E-card, restricted rock paper scissors, 17 steps mahjong, etc, with AI characters as your opponents. You can either make your own opponents or find AI characters cards online.

You are able to talk to the characters to bluff or manipulate them, interact with the environment to cheat, steal or whatever.

Basically, take advantage of the interactivity of AI to come up with creative ways to win and have intense psychological battles. The NPCs are also capable of cheating and playing differently based on their character profile and its up to you figure out how to survive.

So far, I vibe coded a working E-card prototype with chat functionality but its still very rough.

I wanna know what you guys think if its possible.

comments.body: It’s all possible. Ai’s not the blocker, your imagination/vision and perseverance are.
